name: System Design
description: The process of defining the architecture, components, modules, interfaces, and data for a system to satisfy specified requirements and scale efficiently.

name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
description: An AI framework combining external knowledge retrieval with generative LLMs to produce accurate, context-rich, and grounded responses.

name: Chatbot Development
description: Designing, building, and deploying conversational AI agents and interactive dialogue systems across platforms using NLP, LLMs, and intent-recognition frameworks.

name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
description: An open standard protocol that enables AI models and assistants to securely access external tools, prompts, and context resources across distributed clients and servers.

name: Unit Testing
description: The practice of writing and executing automated tests to verify individual components or methods of software in isolation using frameworks like JUnit or Mockito.

name: Integration Testing
description: Software testing where individual units and external modules (databases, APIs, message queues) are combined and evaluated together to verify seamless system interoperability.

name: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
description: A modern DevOps methodology and pipeline practice that automates the building, testing, and deployment of code changes to produce rapid, reliable software releases.

name: Hibernate
description: A widely-used Java Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) framework that facilitates mapping domain models to relational database tables and abstracts SQL interactions.

name: Jakarta EE
description: A set of enterprise Java specifications (formerly Java EE) providing foundational enterprise standards such as JPA, Servlets, CDI, JMS, and RESTful web services.

name: Kafka
description: A distributed event streaming platform used for high-throughput data pipelines, real-time analytics, event sourcing, and decoupled pub/sub messaging.

name: Spring MVC
description: A robust Model-View-Controller web framework within the Spring ecosystem that simplifies building RESTful APIs and MVC-based web applications in Java.

name: MySQL
description: A popular open-source relational database management system (RDBMS) based on SQL, known for its reliability, ACID compliance, and multi-tenant performance.

name: Microservices
description: An architectural style that structures an application as a collection of small, independently deployable, loosely coupled, and bounded services communicating via lightweight protocols.

name: Monolithic Architecture
description: A traditional software design model where the entire software system, UI, business logic, and data layer are packaged and deployed as a single unified executable.

name: HTML5
description: The standard markup language used to structure and present content across the World Wide Web, featuring native multimedia, semantic elements, and modern APIs.

name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
description: A comprehensive cloud computing platform offering compute, storage, networking, managed databases, security, and AI/ML services globally.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: An AI-powered pair programmer developed by GitHub and OpenAI that autocompletes code, suggests whole functions, and answers technical questions within IDEs.

name: Claude Skills
description: The capability to configure, extend, and integrate Claude AI models with customized tools, system prompts, API functions, and contextual workflows.

name: Docker
description: An open platform for developing, shipping, and running applications inside lightweight, portable, and isolated containers across environments.

name: WebSockets
description: A bidirectional, full-duplex communication protocol operating over a single TCP connection, ideal for real-time applications like chats, live feeds, and notifications.

name: GitHub
description: A cloud-based Git repository hosting and developer platform offering version control, pull requests, issue tracking, CI/CD automation via Actions, and code review.

name: Git
description: A distributed version control system designed to handle everything from small to very large projects with speed, branch management, and collaborative efficiency.

name: Payment Gateways
description: Merchant service mechanisms that authorize credit card or direct payment processing for e-businesses, handling encryption, PCI-DSS compliance, and settlement.

name: REST APIs
description: Representational State Transfer web services that utilize standard HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and stateless client-server conventions for data interchange.

name: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
description: A suite of cloud computing services by Google providing modular cloud storage, compute engines, Kubernetes orchestration, BigQuery analytics, and machine learning tools.

name: Spring Security
description: A powerful, customizable authentication and access-control framework that provides comprehensive security protection for Spring-based Java applications.

name: JWT
description: JSON Web Tokens, a compact, URL-safe means of representing claims to be transferred securely between two parties, widely used for stateless authentication and authorization.

name: OAuth2
description: An industry-standard authorization framework that enables third-party applications to obtain limited access to an HTTP service on behalf of a resource owner.

name: React
description: A declarative, efficient, component-based JavaScript/TypeScript library developed by Meta for building dynamic and interactive user interfaces.

name: Spring Framework
description: An enterprise Java application framework that provides comprehensive infrastructure support including Inversion of Control (IoC), Dependency Injection (DI), and AOP.

name: Spring Boot
description: An opinionated extension of the Spring framework that streamlines configuring, bootstrapping, and launching production-ready, standalone Spring applications.

name: Java
description: A high-level, class-based, object-oriented programming language designed to have as few implementation dependencies as possible (Write Once, Run Anywhere).

name: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)
description: A stylesheet language used to describe the presentation, layout, typography, and visual design of documents written in HTML or other markup languages.

name: NodeJs
description: An open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment built on Chrome's V8 engine that executes JavaScript code outside a web browser using an event-driven model.

name: JavaScript
description: A high-level, dynamic, multi-paradigm programming language that serves as the core scripting language of the web alongside HTML and CSS.

name: TypeScript
description: A strongly typed superset of JavaScript developed by Microsoft that compiles to plain JavaScript and adds static type checking and modern tooling support.

name: MongoDB
description: A leading open-source NoSQL document database that stores data in flexible, JSON-like BSON documents with dynamic schemas and high horizontal scalability.

name: ExpressJs
description: A minimal and flexible Node.js web application framework that provides a robust set of features for routing, middleware handling, and RESTful API development.

name: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
description: A programming paradigm based on the concept of objects containing data (attributes) and code (methods), organized through encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction.

name: Back-End Web Development
description: The discipline of designing, building, and maintaining the server-side architecture, APIs, business logic, database integrations, and authentication of web applications.

name: Communication
description: The ability to convey technical concepts clearly, actively listen, collaborate across cross-functional teams, write concise documentation, and facilitate project discussions.

name: Leadership
description: Guiding, mentoring, and empowering team members, making architectural and strategic technical decisions, and driving team success through vision and accountability.

name: Problem Solving
description: The analytical process of diagnosing complex technical issues, evaluating constraints, debugging root causes, and implementing optimal, maintainable software solutions.

name: Research
description: Investigating emerging technologies, evaluating competing libraries or architectures, and synthesizing technical documentation to make informed engineering decisions.
